message: I sat by the window watching the rain slide down the glass while drinking a hot vanilla latte. For the first time in months, I didn't check the time once. Be kind to yourself today — you are doing better than you think.

I failed my first major interview today, but I bought myself a warm honey cake and a used book. The world didn't end. If you are having a difficult day, remember that chapter one is rarely where the hero triumphs.

They were playing an old 1974 vinyl record of jazz piano that my grandfather used to listen to on Sunday mornings. It smelled like roasted coffee and memory. Cherish the people who taught you how to listen.
I finally booked the one-way ticket to follow the craft I love. Terrified, but the coffee here gave me just enough warmth to hit confirm. To whoever reads this: take the leap.
